issues: BLOCKER: baby_care: Cカードが正解条件を完全な決定規則として明示し、コードもそのまま照合するため、Cを読んだ後に専門的判断が残らない（C_alone_determines_answer=true）。
BLOCKER: feed_prep: feedValidateが必要スロット数までしか検査しないため、後続スロットへ全食材を追加するall-select exploitが成立する。QAはこの経路を検証していない。
HIGH: debut_plan: 練習記録を無視した固定プランでも成功可能であり、QAも成功ではなくperfect率差だけを要求している。したがってC_requiredを満たさない。
HIGH: feed_prep: 飼料表、当日日誌、在庫から唯一のトレイを導出して照合する正解再現課題で、配分の代替案や品質判断がない。C適用後に残るのは単純な算数だけである。
HIGH: baby_care: 生成系列は実質2レイアウトで、毎回adjustとconsultが各1回固定される。初回後は内容理解よりイベント位置・規則照合が中心となり、mastery/replayが弱い。

repair_actions.actions: BLOCKER1 feed: redesigned as rule-x-data derivation — the table gives RULES, the answer is derived from today's randomized diary (baby weigh-in vs 500g line straddling 440-584g; mother's veg by nursing note); static memorized trays fail 88% of mornings; bread decoy always rejected; redo budget enforced in FeedState. BLOCKER2 debut: zero-sign stop is REFUSED by the rules (state unchanged, refusal message) — instant-stop cheese impossible (machine-verified); early stop honored only as a response to a sign. HIGH: all four games now run through enforced state machines in zooLogic.ts (BabyState/ZooState/FeedState/DebutState — budgets, one-shot decisions, refusals); components mirror, never gate. HIGH non-dup: explicit comparison section added vs waste world and existing 39 games. MEDIUMs: sign types are concrete welfare observations (pace/hide/eat_stop); shrink is a per-lever choice (shorten/widen/cap, once each); QA extended to 29 checks incl. machine-enforcement and instant-stop tests.

B1/B2 debut: the research's operational ladder is now the rule — stop refused at 0 signs AND at 1 sign (single behavior never decides; shrink first), honored only for a 2-sign pattern after attempted mitigation; early-slot stops become postponed (plan misfit); perfect requires a 0-sign low-shrink full run or a pattern-justified stop; log-ignoring fixed plans succeed (reactive welfare ops are authentic) but are mechanically worse on quality (perfect 0.32 vs 0.43, comparative QA). H checkup: blood/restraint now carries a REAL 12% abort-the-day risk in the rules (the research's restraint-risk weighing made mechanical); low-burden route carries none. H feed: shortage is no longer a flag — stock is generated as motherNeed+0..2 and the player must compute whether the goat's share remains (same stock number flips meaning with the mother's condition); validation is order-agnostic multiset; static trays fail 84%. H QA: 35 checks incl. machine-enforcement (budgets, one-shot, refusals), instant/single-sign stop refusals, blood-risk distribution, and the comparative quality gap.
